naslov: Short clip from a lecture (1/6) — 12 December 2025

segmenti.tekst: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ ۝ وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ
segmenti.prevod: “And Sulayman inherited from Dawud and said, ‘O people, we have been taught the language of birds and have been given of everything; indeed, this is evident bounty.’ And there were gathered for Sulayman his soldiers of the jinn…” (An-Naml 27:16–17)
“…and men and birds, and they were marching in ranks.” (An-Naml 27:17)

segmenti.tekst: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
segmenti.prevod: “Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, ‘O ants, enter your dwellings so that Sulayman and his soldiers do not crush you while they do not perceive it.’” (An-Naml 27:18)

segmenti.tekst: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ
segmenti.prevod: “So he smiled, amused at its words, and said, ‘My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me…’” (An-Naml 27:19)
“…and admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.’” (An-Naml 27:19)
